title: Dew-Kissed Rose
description: A close-up shot of a single, partially opened rose. The rose is predominantly a deep crimson red on the outer petals, gradually transitioning to a lighter pink or white towards the center. Water droplets are visible on the petals, suggesting recent rain or dew. The background is blurred, showing a green foliage, indicative of a garden setting. Other roses are visible in the soft-focus background, suggesting a rose bush or garden bed.
